calibration.allowed_source: clean representative windows from the frozen development/calibration partition only
calibration.selection_rule: Calibration configuration may be selected only with development/calibration evidence.

fallback_policy.if_static_ptq_is_unsuitable: retain validated FP32 baseline or define a separate explicitly justified deployment variant
fallback_policy.reason: QAT changes recovered historical task weights and therefore changes baseline identity.

quantizer_selection_prohibitions: do not choose using final-test accuracy
do not choose using sensor-fault robustness
do not choose using compute-fault robustness
do not choose using combined-fault robustness
do not choose using publication-facing final confirmation
reason: Preserve the validated historical task weights while calibrating activation ranges from a frozen clean calibration split.
structural_acceptance_gates: no OOD or reliability mechanism introduced
